shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side. A man in an orange shirt sits in the shelf-side window seat and calls the weekly club meeting to order, while a woman in a white shirt sits in the doorway-side window seat, a man in a blue shirt sits in the shelf-side aisle seat, and a woman in a yellow shirt sits in the doorway-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The man in an orange shirt asks about the creative contributions, and the woman in a white shirt answers with the report.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a blue shirt asks about the schedule, the man in an orange shirt replies with the dates, and the woman in a white shirt confirms the meeting plan.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the shelving-unit end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the doorway, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
